The decision-legal grid row (period Sep17) has estimated gas burn 42.7 Bcf/d, gas generation +643,808 MWh WoW and gas share +3.41 points, while wind is -289,173 MWh and -2.73 share points. So I first derive the bearish state from widened storage surplus + fresh loose print, then use demand arrival/tighter supply to shrink it.

The curve is quiet overnight, softens through the US morning, reaches its low around 14 ET, then recovers modestly into the close. Falsifier: a clean non-program buy handover would invalidate continuation, but that future Friday tape is not available at the open. CALL, low-to-medium confidence.
